root_cause: Pass 2 of _assign_units_to_objectives fills COORD-5's need ledger greedily; the projected part of the need is capped (PROJECTED_NEED_CAP), so the centre reads 'already taken' once 1-2 units are sent although the enemy threat there (enemy OC + projected OC) still exceeds what the plan has without the next unit. That unit falls through to a fallback where its OC cannot change control (s7475: lone flip of obj_nml_2, 9 vs ~25 threat, 3 turns; s7455: obj_nml_1, 9 vs 21), and T7-23 then blends 70% of the move toward a charge target, so it neither reaches the fallback nor helps the centre. Decision records: obj_center is the unit's top candidate in every finding (17.5 vs 12.8, 21.8 vs 14.5, 43.9 vs 38.5, 44.4 vs 22.6) and the override note is 'obj_center is already taken by ... - sent to X instead'. A/B at s7421 (2 seeds, base code): B (Gamma to the centre) +4.0 value; all of it is denial - in A the opponent scores 12 VP in round 2 from the centre (Vital Link hold_min +4, hold_central +4, central_operation_markers +4), in B none.
fix_summary: ATTACK-MOVE (FIX_ATTACK_MOVE=1, ATTACK_MOVE_MAX_TURNS=2, ATTACK_MOVE_MIN_SHARE=0.75): in pass 2, just before a unit is assigned to a capture that is NOT its top-scored candidate, if (a) the fallback is futile - the plan's OC there with the unit (LONE-TRIP's ledger: holders + units sent that arrive no later + incoming + unit) is <= the enemy threat there - and (b) the unit's top candidate is a move/advance whose need is filled, reachable within 2 moves, not our home objective, not a RACE-SKIP/TOO-LATE/LONE-TRIP skip, and pivotal - the threat there is >= the plan's OC without the unit and with the unit the plan has >= 75% of the threat and a better share than at the fallback - the unit is assigned to the top objective instead (the candidate's own action, so a Normal move stays a Normal move), with a coordination note. Logs [ATTACK_MOVE] when it changes a decision and [ATTACK_MOVE_CHECK] for each evaluation. Does not touch the chase gate (_melee_chase_gate) or the T7-23 blend, so it composes with waaagh_advance_charge. Param 0 = base exactly (the lambda returns {} first).
related_tests_detail: All 21 listed tests pass on the fix (rollout_override 11/0, e_race_tuning 8/0, race_army 3/0, advance_probability 8/0, objective_race 16/0, plan_diminishing_returns 4/0, critic_round2 7/0, 11e_charge_ev_primary_cap 26/0, movement_decisions 36/0, plan_earmarks 35/0, fix_held_dup 14/0, fix_lone_trip 8/0, fix_charge_ev 11/0, fix_far_trip 11/0, fix_overcommit 8/0, fix_keeper_release 52/0, fix_lone_flip 16/0, fix_reinforce_insurance 24/0, charge_decisions 62/0, survival_assessment 23/0, multi_phase_planning 34/0); test_ai_threat_range_awareness 34/3 = the known base failures. New test 6/0 on fix, 4/2 on BASE (the two redirect checks fail). Test drives _assign_units_to_objectives with real evaluations.

fires: Replays (one game each, rounds 2-3 or 3-4, both players): f1 1, f2 1, f3 3 (Guard Alpha -> obj_nml_1, Thunderwolf Cavalry B -> obj_center, Outrider Squad A -> obj_center; not the decision unit), f4 1, g1 0, g2 0, g3 2 (Warbikers A -> obj_center, Guard Delta -> obj_nml_1; not the decision unit), g4 0, g5 0 = 9 fires in 9 replays. Bench reach (mirror_custodes_2000_postdeploy, seed 93101, 1 pair, full 5-round games): game M1 0 fires, game M2 2 fires (Allarus Custodians -> obj_center instead of obj_home_2; Guard Beta -> obj_nml_2 instead of obj_center). That pair: E -24.0 (margins -53 and -5), n=1 - noise-level, but negative.
risks: Rounds 3-5: the trigger can refire each round, so a unit can keep being pulled to a contested top objective instead of spreading; secondary cards that pay for spread (Engage on All Fronts, table quarters, Outflank, secondary_spread) may lose 2-5 VP when the redirected unit would otherwise have reached a flank, even if it could not flip it - a futile flip still scores quarter/spread secondaries. Mitigation: only when the fallback is futile AND the top is pivotal, only top objectives within 2 moves and never our home (the unit always goes forward, not back - the round-2 FAR-TRIP failure mode was holding units back), the top keeps its own scored action. Denial value lasts (opponent's hold_central/central markers every round), which the share test captures only indirectly. Late rounds: stacking a contested centre in rounds 4-5 converts to primary only if the plan's share holds; with MIN_SHARE 0.75 the plan may still lose the centre and the unit then scored nothing anywhere. The strongest finding (s7421) is not changed; the 1-pair bench came out -24 (n=1, not significant) - a full-game bench is required before shipping. MIN_SHARE 0.75 and MAX_TURNS 2 are untuned.
